channel.title: How to End War and Disease
channel.description:
Get 443 Years of Clinical Research Done in 36, Avoid the Apocalypse, and Make Humanity Filthy Rich Through the Magic of Legal Bribery.

Your choice to listen is the highest-value decision any human has ever made. You are about to prevent 10.7 billion deaths, eliminate 1.93 quadrillion hours of human suffering, and prevent the apocalypse as a bonus.

I started watching your planet in 1945 when you split the atom. "Atom" comes from your Greek word meaning "unable to be cut," so naturally, you cut it. I assumed you were trying to unlock unlimited free energy. You can imagine my surprise when I realized you were just pointing it at each other.

150,000 of you permanently stop every 24 hours from diseases that are basically just bugs in your meat software. Your chance of dying from terrorism: 1 in 30 million. Your chance of dying from disease: 100%. If cancer had oil reserves, you would have cured it by 2003.

This book teaches humanity to redirect 1% of the murder budget to medicine. It's like weaning a baby off eating paint chips. You can't just take away all the paint chips at once. They'll cry. You have to gradually replace paint chips with food until they forget paint chips were ever an option. Nobody has to become a better person. You just point everyone's greed at diseases instead of each other.

Vote to redirect 1% of the murder budget to medicine. It takes 15 seconds and mass participation makes the treaty politically unavoidable.
